product.title: Rome: Vatican Museums and St. Peter's Basilica Small Group Tour

description.text: In Rome, avoid being just a number on an impersonal large tour and enjoy an intimate experience on this small-group tour of the Vatican Museums and St. Peter’s Basilica. Save time with skip-the-line access so you can go straight to the stunning art and architecture. Stops include Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, St. Peter's Basilica. Listen to your guide’s interesting commentary as they lead you through the rich, ornate Vatican Museums, the Sistine Chapel, and St. Peter's Basilica. Ideal for visitors basing in Rome who want a guided city experience without coordinating Metro routes, attraction tickets, or landmark timing on their own. Routes stay oriented to Vatican Museums, Sistine Chapel, St. Peter's Basilica that define this Rome sightseeing experience, with a guide handling Metro connections, ticket windows, and neighborhood pacing so the day stays focused on the city rather than logistics.
